title: Schools Near Me Map: Schools Around Any Place
description: Map the schools near any place with the Schools Near Me Map — schools recorded in open data, each with its straight-line distance. Free.
summary_sentence: Results are limited to returned OpenStreetMap records and may omit closer or unmapped places. Confirm details with an authoritative local source.
quick_answer: The tool searches OpenStreetMap for mapped school records around a chosen location, then sorts returned records by straight-line distance. It requests at most 200 records and displays up to 100, so it cannot guarantee the closest result or a complete list. Data, access and opening status can be incomplete or outdated.

faq: Where does the school data come from?
OpenStreetMap's community records — schools mapped by locals, updated continuously. Depth is excellent in populated areas and thinner where mapping is sparse.
Is the distance the school run distance?
No — it is the straight-line distance, labelled as such. The run follows roads; the Walking Route Planner computes that version for a chosen school.
Can I use the tool without sharing my precise location?
You can search for a place instead of using device location. The selected search centre is sent to OpenStreetMap-based services for the lookup.
Why might a boundary or place name look different elsewhere?
Schools rename, merge and move; the record carries the name at mapping time, and districts publish the current truth.
Does MapBench store my browser location?
Device location is optional. The selected coordinates are sent to Overpass to search; consult the privacy page for provider and site details.
Which school will my child attend?
That is the district's assignment, not this map's list — School District Context exists to walk you to the official answer.
Private schools included?
Where recorded as schools, yes — the record does not filter by sector.
Nurseries and colleges?
Recorded educational sites can appear depending on tagging; the list's design centre is schools proper.
A school is missing or closed.
Map data ages at the edges. The district's own list is definitive, and the open map accepts your correction for the next family.
School ratings or Ofsted grades?
Not here — inspection and performance data live with the official bodies (Ofsted, state report cards). This map's honest layer is location.
Faith and specialist schools?
Names usually carry the character; the schools' own pages confirm. The record's job is that they appear at all.
